what: a 3 mm chamfer on the top front edge, then r2 rounds on the front vertical edges that meet it
method: the chamfer removes 3^2/2 60. The front vertical edges then run z 0..17; each r2 round removes (1-pi/4) 2^2 17 below and runs on up into the chamfer face z = 17 + y: over its section it removes a column y high, int y dA = (1-pi/4) 2^2 x 2 (10-3pi)/(12-3pi) (the section's centroid). Faces 6 + chamfer + 2 rounds; vertices: 6 round the bottom, 4 of the top face, the front face's 2 top corners, the 2 tops of the rounds' tangent lines on the ends (z = 19): 14; edges 21 (Euler)
